name: Caldo de verduras
source:
Fed up with his wife's semi-secret lesbian affairs, the protagonist and her father suddenly move to a city aptly named "Big Apple." With no dreams, hopes, or much savings, she'll spend the rest of her life trying to make up for lost time. But what's (15-21 years), compared to something that can't be more than two months?

[Translated from [url=https://kommei.itch.io/mec]itch.io[/url]]
